waiting: Waiting for controller data… press a button.
genericLayout: Automatic layout built from the detected buttons and axes

guided.title: Guided button test
guided.intro: The app asks for one button at a time. Press it when it shows up. There is no time limit: if a button does not respond, mark it as "not working".
guided.promptHint: The button is highlighted on the controller drawing.
guided.wrong: Got {got} instead of {want}. If this keeps happening, the buttons may be swapped.
guided.navPaused: Navigating the app with the controller is paused during the test. Use the keyboard (Esc leaves the test).
guided.demoNote: In demo mode the simulated controller presses the requested button by itself.

health.title: Button health
health.intro: Finds a faulty button before you buy parts: double clicks (chatter), presses that never arrive, sticking buttons and bounce on release. You press each chosen button a number of times at your own pace, then hold it once. Nothing is written to the controller.
health.precisionHid: Direct reading (HID): the app sees every report from the controller. Only glitches shorter than the gap between two reports (a few milliseconds) go unnoticed.
health.precisionSystem: Read through the system ({backend}): the app only sees state changes at the polling rate, so very fast chatter can slip by. If you can, connect a DualSense or DualShock 4 over USB, which is read directly (HID) and more precisely.
health.chooseHint: Start with the suspects. Each button takes less than a minute.
health.fromGuided: Buttons that failed or were skipped in the guided test are already ticked.
health.includeHoldHint: Shows whether the button lets go on its own while you hold it.
health.navPaused: Navigating the app with the controller is paused during the test. Use the keyboard or mouse (Esc cancels).
health.demoNote: In demo mode the simulated controller presses by itself, and its R1 is faulty on purpose.
health.tapHint: At your own pace, no rush: press and release normally and count yourself. The counter shows how many presses reached the app. When you have done your {n}, click Done; whatever the counter is short of counts as presses that did not register.
health.holdPrompt: Now hold {button} until the bar fills
health.holdHint: Hold it down for {s} seconds. The bar only fills while the app sees the button pressed.
health.heldEarly: The bar did not fill. Did you let go of the button?
health.notReleased: I did not — it let go by itself

reasons.chatter: {count} press(es) with chatter: more than one click at the start of a single press.
reasons.releaseBounce: {count} press(es) with bounce: extra clicks when letting go.
reasons.noPresses: No press reached the app ({count} requested).
reasons.slowRelease: {count} press(es) took much longer than the others to come back up.
reasons.stuckPress: Stayed pressed for more than 8 seconds ({count} time(s)).
reasons.neverReleased: Was still pressed after the test ended.
reasons.selfRelease: Let go by itself {count} time(s) while held.

advice.clean: Clean it: the contact may be dirty or oxidised. With the controller off, clean under the button cap with isopropyl alcohol and test again.
advice.replaceCap: Replace the button cap: a loose or bent cap, or one that does not reach the switch, causes missed presses and sticking.
advice.replaceSwitch: Replace the switch: the contact is worn and cleaning rarely helps. The part to buy is that button's switch (microswitch).

health.precisionReport: Precision of this session: one report every {ms} ms (HID).
health.precisionEvent: Precision of this session: only state changes seen by the system. Very fast chatter may not have shown up.
health.checkHealth: Check the health of these buttons
health.checkHealthHint: Measures chatter, missed presses, sticking and release bounce on the buttons that failed or were skipped.

vibration.title: Rumble test
vibration.noRumble: This controller did not report rumble motors (or the current connection does not allow it).
vibration.motorTestHint: Weak for 1 s, strong for 1 s, then both together.
vibration.visualNote: Every rumble also shows on screen: the controller drawing shakes (or its outline pulses with reduced motion) and the bars show the intensity.

dualsense.title: DualSense: adaptive triggers and lights
dualsense.hint: Press L2/R2 after applying to feel the effect. Effects stay on until turned off or the controller disconnects.

ghosting.title: Ghosting and rollover
ghosting.intro: Hold several buttons at the same time. If one does not register while the others are held, it turns red.
ghosting.rolloverHint: Most chosen buttons registered at the same time.
ghosting.ghostFound: Possible ghosting: {list} did not register together with the others.
ghosting.demoNote: The demo has a deliberate fault: with 4 or more buttons held, □ does not register.
